message.content: {"note_claim": "The note claims that the Houthis (Ansarallah) are US-designated terrorists.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "I'm pleased to announce the Department's designation of Ansarallah, commonly referred to as the Houthis, as a Foreign Terrorist Organization.", "reason": "The page directly confirms the US designation of Ansarallah/Houthis as a Foreign Terrorist Organization, substantiating the note's characterization."}

parsed.note_claim: The note claims that the Houthis (Ansarallah) are US-designated terrorists.
